status: synthetic trusted plaintext prototype; not production cryptography

catalog.labels: public ordered unique UTF-8 labels, 1..64 bytes each, 1..64 buckets
catalog.digest: SHA-256 of canonical JSON ordered labels, with UTF-8/ensure_ascii=False
catalog.mutability: insert-only IDs; repeated IDs reject; no management API
catalog.snapshot_binding: tenant, domain, snapshot ID -> one catalog ID; count rejects histogram-tagged snapshots
catalog.missing: trusted per-user contribution preprocessing, assignment-rule version provenance and domain lineage

admission.costs: both dimensions and job inserted atomically in reservation transaction
admission.L1: one independent committed tick persists STARTED plus full 10B-byte random tape before any private read
admission.retry: same operation/action and same tick request return original registration without new sample or charge

scheduler.policy: one shared domain round-robin queue; ordered publication can hold later completed count behind earlier long histogram
scheduler.state: counts[B], alive[B][2], g[B][2], outputs[B], persisted in private_state BLOB as plaintext canonical JSON
scheduler.completion: only final bucket store atomically commits 8B-byte vector, result binding, all charges, final job state and publication eligibility
scheduler.cancel: RESERVED refunds; STARTED burns; both retain full public dummy-slot work
scheduler.revoke_expire: before L1 refunds; after L1 no refund or new tape, full computation can finish but publication withheld

delivery.current: internal existing L3 ticket and emit support complete vector bytes

storage.profile_mixing: new storage profile mutually rejects count services; no implicit conversion

verification.budget_race: 8 simultaneous requests across 2 roots/actors and count/histogram; one budget unit; exactly 1 winner
verification.history_case: count spends, later catalog/snapshot installed, histogram spends remaining same budget, third request rejected
